title: Anticipation with room for joy today

captions.energy: Keeping enjoyment in a waiting state
captions.emotions: Feeling hope for a pleasant meeting

meaning: A tradition can sustain warm anticipation when hope for a future evening leaves room for a small pleasure today.
text: Pleasant anticipation can become part of your shared life in its own right. The Hierophant in the physical position of Svadhisthana describes enjoyment through a familiar tradition: a repeated idea, a known arrangement and a small sign of an approaching meeting. The Hanged Man in energy leans towards holding desire in waiting and reconsidering conditions before beginning. The Star in emotions allows hope for pleasure ahead. Tradition recalls available enjoyment, the delaying motive keeps it in the future, and anticipation can sustain that picture without an actual experience together.

Suppose you usually bake shaped biscuits at the beginning of a season. The cutters are out, but the evening waits for a free week and a more suitable mood. **Warm anticipation can have a small continuation today.** You can choose one shape and make a simple batch without arranging the entire familiar celebration. The smell of baking and an amusing uneven biscuit give expectation a living foundation.

The difficulty is protecting hope so carefully that a real evening seems insufficient for it. You wait longer and grow less willing to test the pleasant picture through experience. Tradition survives mainly as a promise. Another perspective helps when it restores participation. A modest version takes no beauty from the future; it lets you both feel that pleasure exists beyond anticipation alone.
